title: WoW-Bench: Evaluating Fine-Grained Acoustic Perception in Audio-Language Models via Marine Mammal Vocalizations
abstract: arXiv:2508.20976v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large audio-language models (LALMs) extend language understanding into the auditory domain, yet their ability to perform low-level listening, such as pitch and duration detection, remains underexplored. However, low-level listening is critical for real-world, out-of-distribution tasks where models must reason about unfamiliar sounds based on fine-grained acoustic cues. To address this gap, we introduce the World-of-Whale benchmark (WoW-Bench) to evaluate low-level auditory perception and cognition using marine mammal vocalizations. We use marine mammal vocalizations as out-of-distribution sound events to better assess models' low-level listening and so that the models do not rely on prior knowledge of the sound events. WoW-bench is composed of a Perception benchmark for categorizing novel sounds and a Cognition benchmark, inspired by Bloom's taxonomy, to assess the abilities to remember, understand, apply, and analyze sound eve

translated_title: WoW-Bench：通过海洋哺乳动物发声评估音频-语言模型中的细粒度声学感知
translated_abstract: 大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）将语言理解扩展到了听觉领域，但它们执行低层次听力任务（如音调和时长检测）的能力仍未得到充分探索。然而，低层次听力对于现实世界中的分布外任务至关重要，在这些任务中，模型必须基于细粒度的声学线索对不熟悉的声音进行推理。为了填补这一空白，我们引入了鲸鱼世界基准测试，利用海洋哺乳动物的发声来评估低层次听觉感知和认知。我们使用海洋哺乳动物发声作为分布外声音事件，以便更好地评估模型的低层次听力，并确保模型不依赖于对声音事件的先验知识。WoW-Bench由两部分组成：一个用于对新声音进行分类的感知基准，以及一个受布鲁姆分类法启发的认知基准，用于评估模型记忆、理解、应用和分析声音事件的能力。
tldr: 提出了WoW-Bench基准测试，利用海洋哺乳动物发声作为分布外声音事件，从感知和认知两个层面评估音频-语言模型的低层次听觉能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes WoW-Bench, a benchmark that uses marine mammal vocalizations as out-of-distribution sound events to evaluate low-level auditory perception and cognition in audio-language models across perception and cognition dimensions.
